## Summary

Describe the change and link any related issue.

## Verification

List the checks or tests performed and their outcomes.

## Research impact

State whether this changes preprocessing, model behavior, evaluation or figure
generation. Describe any effect on existing reproduction instructions.

## Checklist

- [ ] Contributions contain source, documentation or tests; datasets and checkpoints remain separate.
- [ ] Shared examples and logs are checked for credentials and personal information.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Third-party attribution and applicable license terms are preserved.
